static_references.text: - Config-only external-data validation change: set `data_source.backend: pcap` and `data_source.pcap_path: data/external/timesafe_prod_successful_announce_attack_ptp.pcap` after downloading the public TIMESAFE capture from `genesys-neu/s-plane_security`.

("scripts/prepare_timesafe_sessions.py","77","Prepares the real TIMESAFE captures into clean sessions."),
("Raw .pcap files (data/external/s-plane_security_repo/)","REAL packets","several","Original packet captures the CSVs are derived from."),
["scripts/prepare_timesafe_sessions.py", "77", "Prepares public TIMESAFE captures into capture-isolated sessions."]],
